Corollary
[exhaustion energy estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0077 ↗ prop:chow-ii-weighted-l2 1. ch10:10.72\group Weak heat solutions

The weighted energy monotonicity passes to a complete noncompact limit of compact exhaustions whenever the approximating solutions converge in $C^2$ on compact subsets.
Proof

\sketch Apply the compact estimate on each exhaustion domain, then use $C^2$ convergence on compact sets and monotone convergence for the nonnegative integrands.

□
